loan.title: Loan repayments
loan.sentence: Borrow <principal/> at <rate/> a year, <method/>, over <term/> <unit/>, paid <freq/>.

errors.principal: The loan amount must be more than zero.
errors.term: The term must be a whole number above zero, up to 60 years.
errors.periods: That term doesn't split into equal payments. Quarterly needs months divisible by 3, yearly by 12.

loan.because:
Over {{n}} payments you repay

{{principal}}

of principal and {{interest}} of interest. Interest is {{share}}% of everything you pay.
loan.flatTruth: A {{rate}}% flat rate costs about as much as {{effective}}% a year on a reducing balance. Compare loans using that figure.
loan.chartAlt: Stacked bars: principal and interest paid in each year
loan.formula: P is the loan, r the annual rate divided by payments per year, n the number of payments. Each period's interest is rounded to the satang and the last payment absorbs what rounding leaves.
loan.formulaFlat: R is the annual rate, Y the number of years, n the number of payments. Interest is charged on the original amount for the whole term and split evenly. The equivalent reducing-balance rate comes from the same payments.

savings.title: Savings interest
savings.sentence: Keep <principal/> in savings at <rate/> a year from <start/> until <end/>.

errors.eventDate: Deposits and withdrawals must fall between the start and withdrawal dates.
errors.overdrawn: That withdrawal is more than the balance on the day.

savings.because:
Over {{days}} days the account earns {{gross}} before tax, {{tax}} is withheld, and

{{balance}}

is there on the day you withdraw. Interest is paid on 30 June and 31 December.
savings.taxUnder: In {{year}} interest totals {{gross}}, {{diff}} under the {{limit}} tax-free limit, so no tax is withheld.
savings.taxOver: In {{year}} interest totals {{gross}}, {{diff}} over the {{limit}} tax-free limit, so the bank withholds 15% of the whole year's interest: {{tax}}.
savings.formula: Interest accrues every night on that night's balance, divided by 365 (Actual/365), and is paid on 30 June, 31 December and the withdrawal date. Savings interest up to ฿20,000 a year is tax-free; above that, the bank withholds 15% of the whole year's interest.

fixed.title: Fixed deposit
fixed.sentence: Put <principal/> in a fixed deposit at <rate/> a year for <term/>, <rounds/> times in a row, starting <start/>.
fixed.compound: add the interest to the deposit

errors.rounds: The number of rounds must be a whole number from 1 to 100.

fixed.because:
On {{date}} you have

{{balance}}

. Interest before tax is {{gross}}, and {{tax}} is withheld.
fixed.formula: Interest counts the actual days from deposit to maturity, divided by 365. Every maturity is counted from the first start date, so a deposit opened at month end keeps maturing at month end. Fixed deposit interest is taxed 15% unless the account is tax-free.
fixed.compareNote: Each bank's highest rate as reported to the Bank of Thailand. {{bank}} pays the most. Actual rates can depend on the amount and the account's conditions.

tiered.title: Tiered-rate deposit
tiered.sentence: Keep <principal/> in a tiered-rate account from <start/> until <end/>.

errors.upper: Each tier must end above where it starts.

tiered.because:
Over {{days}} days the deposit earns {{gross}} before tax, {{tax}} is withheld, and you withdraw

{{balance}}

.
tiered.formula: Each slice of the balance earns its own tier's rate, and anything above the top tier earns the top rate. Simple interest on actual days divided by 365.

fv.title: Future value
fv.sentence: Invest <pv/> now and add <c/> <freq/> <timing/>, earning <rate/> a year for <years/> years.

labels.timing: Start or end of each period

timing.end: at the end of the period
timing.begin: at the start of the period

errors.rate: The rate must be above -100% and at most 100%.
errors.years: The number of years must be a whole number from 1 to 100.

fv.because:
You put in

{{invested}}

and compounding adds {{growth}}, {{share}}% of what you end up with.
fv.chartTitle: What you put in, and what it grew, year by year
fv.chartAlt: Stacked bars: money put in and growth at the end of each year
fv.formula: PV is the starting amount, C what you add each period, r the annual return divided by periods per year, n the number of periods. Adding at the start of a period multiplies the C part by (1 + r) once more. Real returns vary from year to year.

npv.title: Net present value
npv.sentence: Invest <initial/> today, discount at <rate/> a year, and get money back <freq/>:

errors.none: Add at least one period of money coming back.
errors.flow: Enter this period's amount (negative if you pay more in).

npv.worth:
Worth it with a discount rate of {{rate}}%: what comes back is worth

{{returns}}

today, more than the {{initial}} you put in.
npv.notWorth:
Not worth it with a discount rate of {{rate}}%: what comes back is worth

{{returns}}

today, less than the {{initial}} you put in.
npv.irr: The internal rate of return (IRR) is about {{irr}}% a year, the discount rate at which NPV is zero.
npv.noIrr: There is no internal rate of return (IRR): the money coming back never breaks even.
npv.formula: C₀ is the investment today, Cₜ the money back in period t, r the annual discount rate divided by periods per year.

about.title: About Money-Math
about.intro: Money-Math (formerly Basic Financial Calculator) works out loans, deposits and the time value of money. Each calculator asks its question as a sentence to fill in, follows Thai banks' rules, and answers with a passbook-style schedule.
rules: Deposits earn interest for every night the money is in the account: actual days divided by 365 (Actual/365).
Savings accounts pay interest on 30 June, 31 December and the day you withdraw.
Savings interest up to ฿20,000 a year is tax-free. Above that, the bank withholds 15% of the whole year's interest.
Fixed deposit interest is taxed 15% unless you choose a tax-free account.
Loan interest is rounded to the satang each period and the last payment absorbs the remainder. Flat-rate loans also show their equivalent reducing-balance rate.
about.privacy: Every calculation runs in your browser. What you type lives only in the page's link, so you can share a link and the other person sees the same numbers. There are no accounts and no tracking. Your device remembers only the language, theme and text size you chose.
about.data: Each bank's deposit rates come from what banks reported to the Bank of Thailand on the latest business day. Actual rates can depend on the amount and the account's conditions.
about.disclaimer: Results are estimates at a fixed rate, not an offer or advice from a bank. Check the real figures with your bank before deciding.
